svg.aria-label: Impact. Outcomes, not output. 94% operating cost reduction through an autonomous agentic support solution in the banking sector. 90%+ man-hours saved with an AI-powered credit-analysis application. End-to-end delivery ownership as solo architect of front-end, back-end, AI agents and automation. Core payments migration, release and versioning lead on IBM AS/400 in banking.
